rachats.citation: On June 10, 2024, we announced the signing of a definitive agreement to acquire Belcan, a portfolio company of AE Industrial Partners and a leading global supplier of engineering research & development services, for a preliminary purchase price of approximately $1.3 billion in cash and stock.
